messages:
incident-bot: ALERT -> severity: P1 paging oncall. Metric: inference-runtime latency_p99 spike. p95: 420ms -> 1.2s, p99: 1.0s -> 4.6s over last 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate (streaming), /v1/chat. Link: https://dash.redwood/boards/latency?view=prod&since=5m IncidentID: INC-1738250000

oncall-ryan: taking this. pinging @sre-anna @platform-ops. I'll join huddle if needed.

sre-anna: ack. pulling up per-model and per-route histograms now. any customer-reported errors? @support-lina

support-lina: we got 2 support tickets marked high: VectorSearchCorp (streaming timeouts) and Botsly (partial responses & reconnects). Both started ~5m ago. No new auth errors.

platform-ops: quick look at infra: worker-pool-12 queues spiked. autoscaler triggered 2 extra pods but they were slow to become Ready. GC/pinned memory warnings seen in node-17 around same time. running quick log checks: `kubectl logs -n prod worker-pool-12 --since=10m | grep -E "KV cache|evict|OOM" | tail -n 50`

oncall-ryan: any recent deploys? deploy-bot, status?

deploy-bot: No production deploys in last 30 minutes. Canary pipeline idle.

sre-anna: ok, correlating: p99 increase strongly matches requests with seq_len >1024 and streaming clients that maintain long-lived connections. Runtime metrics show KV cache eviction rate jumped 3x at the same timestamp. hypothesis: cache churn causing long tail token generation stalls.

platform-ops: we can do short mitigation: route ~10-15% of traffic to model-quantized-4bit variant and reduce per-request memory pressure. Can do via runtime-routing toggle now. Anyone object?

pm-maya: do it. We need to protect latency-sensitive customers asap. notify support so they can message affected customers.

oncall-ryan: also can flip a runtime flag to disable chunked streaming for lower tiers to reduce concurrent contexts. Command I'll run: `curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"flag":"disable_chunked_stream","scope":"tier-low","reason":"latency spike mitigation"}'`

platform-ops: routing fallback applied: 12% traffic -> model-quantized-4bit. flag applied for tier-low. seeing early signal: p95 dropping in region-west from 680ms -> 370ms. p99 still elevated at ~2.1s. partial improvement.

sre-anna: good news. start collecting detailed traces for requests with seq_len>1024. add a sampling rule: `runtime.trace.sample_rate("seq_len>1024") = 1/10` and capture KV cache state. Also grab a few gcore/heap snapshots from affected pods.

platform-ops: running sampling change now. commands: ```
# sampling
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/trace-rules -d '{"rule":"seq_len>1024","rate":0.1}'
# capture logs
kubectl exec -n prod worker-pool-12 -- curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache
```

support-lina: customer comms: sent interim update to VectorSearchCorp and Botsly with suggested workaround (reduce context size, retry with smaller batch). Both acknowledged, one asked for ETA.

oncall-ryan: thanks. I'll mark incident as "mitigated -> partial" in the incident tracker. leaving channel in 10m for eng-runtime to follow up. Assign follow-ups: ENG-RT-253 (resize KV cache), ENG-RT-254 (autoscaler tuning), ENG-OBS-99 (improve alert thresholds to include seq_len segmentation).

sre-anna: postmortem notes: likely root cause = sudden shift in workload mix -> more long-context streaming + high cache eviction -> elevated tail. Next actions: increase KV cache capacity on worker-pool-12, tune autoscaler cooldown and scale-up aggressiveness, add stricter circuit-breaker for streaming long contexts.

platform-ops: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/latency-fallback (contains quick rollback and routing toggles).

incident-bot: UPDATE -> severity downgraded to WARNING. Alert suppression active for 30m. Continue monitoring.

oncall-ryan: handing off to eng-runtime oncall at 0900 UTC for deep dive and postmortem. If severity re-escalates ping me. :phone:  :thumbsup:

support-lina: will keep customers updated. created support-incident references REQ-173825-A and REQ-173825-B.

sre-anna: attaching quick log excerpt from worker-pool-12 showing KV eviction noise: ```
[2024-06-12T14:02:10Z] WARN kv_cache: evict key=ctx-9f3a, reason=mem_pressure
[2024-06-12T14:02:11Z] WARN kv_cache: evict key=ctx-1b2c, reason=mem_pressure
[2024-06-12T14:02:12Z] WARN runtime: stall detected, tokens_generated=128, elapsed=4.2s
```

platform-ops: added temporary capacity (2 pods) and bumped node autoscaler max for the pool. watching.

oncall-ryan: thanks all. leaving channel; will follow up in postmortem doc.

platform-ops: note for postmortem: capture exact request IDs flagged by support and match to traces. assign to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

sre-anna: adding final note: adjust p99 alerting to use a weighted percentile that excludes cold-starts and very-long-context sample windows so we don’t get noisy P99s from a small fraction of edge cases.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED -> mitigation stable for 20m, follow-ups created.
